title: odd-checkbox-group
description: A named group of `odd-checkbox` choices with one legend, description, and error. Each choice keeps its own name, value, and checkedness; the group adds `required` (at least one checked) and `disabled` for all of them.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

required.description: At least one choice must be checked to submit.

orientation.description: Stacks the choices, or lines them up and wraps them.
